knownIssues.symptom: A hitch of about a tenth of a second roughly once a second, in menus, the garage and while driving

Liveries look washed out or missing (the car shows mostly its base paint), factory paint has blotchy, faceted reflections, and trees sway oddly (an M5 in highball#290, an M5 Pro in highball-db#449, an M4 Max)
Snow and patches of ground can turn black (an M5 Pro in highball-db#449)
Dialogue, the navigator's voice and most of the engine sound are missing, on any Mac with a two-channel output such as its speakers or headphones (an M5 Max, an M5 Pro, an M5, an M2 Pro)
FHE21 right after the splash, or a Wine crash, when forzahorizon6.exe is added to Highball and started by itself (highball#319, #486, #550)
A freeze of several seconds in all, in one burst, about half a minute into the first drive after starting the game (native arm64 engine)
On the native arm64 route, the game crashes the moment a controller is used (M5 Max, highball#618)
On the native arm64 route, speech and commentary don't play and the car's sound is missing head on, heard only when viewing from the sides (M3 Pro, engine arm64-kk-wine11.18-r4, highball-db#1318)

notes: See the upstream recipe for its full Highball setup.
